state.description:
Saga lifecycle state. RECEIVED, UNFULFILLABLE and CANCELLED are
terminal; every other state is waiting for a next step.
state.title: TransferState

pickedQuantity.description: Units the origin pick actually picked; present from PICKED onwards (may be short of quantity).

originSiteId.description: Facility-layout Site code identifying one warehouse.
originSiteId.title: SiteID

destinationSiteId.description: Facility-layout Site code identifying one warehouse.
destinationSiteId.title: SiteID

reservationId.description: inventory-storage's reservation id, present once ALLOCATED.

rejectionReason.description: The closed rejection reason, present once UNFULFILLABLE.

updatedAt.description: Time of the last state transition; a non-terminal transfer whose updatedAt is old is stuck.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version (the number of persisted state transitions).

total.description: Number of transfers matching the filter before paging.
